finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject a malicious URL that includes shell metacharacters or control operators.
finding.assumptions: The 'url' variable is attacker-controlled and can be manipulated to include shell metacharacters or control operators.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the sink function send_request: it constructs an HTTP request string using snprintf (lines 21-28) and then sends it over a socket with send (line 30). No system(), exec(), or shell invocation occurs. The 'url' variable is only used as the Host header value, which is transmitted over the network, not executed by the local shell. Therefore, there is no OS command injection path.
